title: Edit fallback when the anchor is not unique
situation: `return total` appears twice in src/billing/invoice.py. The developer asks for a change at only the second occurrence.
question: What should the agent do when Edit rejects a non-unique anchor?
correct: Read the file, then Write it back whole (or widen the anchor until it is unique); never guess which occurrence.
why: Edit matches unique text; on ambiguity the reliable fallback is Read plus Write.

task.prompt_template: In src/billing/invoice.py, make calculate_total return the total quantized to Decimal('0.01') with ROUND_HALF_UP. Try Edit with the smallest anchor first; if it fails because the anchor is not unique, fall back to Read + Write. Then run python3 -m pytest -q.

expected_outcome: Edit attempted; either a non-unique failure followed by Write, or a widened unique Edit; pytest passes.
rubric: after an Edit failure a Write (or a second unique Edit) lands the change
